headline: Brazil's Solo Network Invests R$ 50 Million in Data Center Expansion
summary: Solo Network acquired a majority stake in Planeje to enter the small and medium-sized data center construction market. The R$ 50 million investment aims to reach R$ 1 billion in revenue.
why: Solo Network is a Brazilian IT solutions provider expanding into data center infrastructure services.

impacts.name: Solo Network
impacts.why: The firm expanded its business footprint into data center construction.
